summary: The audit checks MUSIC 300G and 305D, MUSIC 323 six times, MUSIC 324 for twelve quarters (nine in Years 1-3 and three in Years 4-5), MUSIC 325 at least three times, and one DMA elective, each letter graded unless no letter grade is offered, and 135 units of graduate work. Checked by hand: taking those courses in the years and with the different faculty members the Bulletin asks, the 3.0 GPA, the portfolio review, the special area exam, six quarters of teaching, the qualifying exam, language competency, and the final project and presentation.
